summary: A JLT dental centre appears to lose bookings to conflicting hours, dead menu items and no scheduler.

findings.problem: The hours appear as Sunday to Friday 8am to 7pm, open 7 days from 8am to 8pm, and Friday 10am to 8pm in different places.
findings.cost: Patients may arrive when you are closed.

findings.problem: Dental Implants, Media and Our Clinic menu items appear to link to #, and icon names such as Phone-alt appear as visible text.
findings.cost: Visitors hit dead ends and see leftover code names.

findings.problem: Book Appointment appears to go to the contact page and the FAQ appears to mention an online booking system with no visible link.
Typos such as gingivitis affective and apart of the plan appear, and copy appears to end mid sentence in places.
findings.cost: Typos and cut off text on a medical site reduce trust.
